notes.title: We haven't forgotten you... (first Space Ribbon major build update since 2019!)
notes.content:
[b]Hey! It's been a minute... roughly 4 years, a pandemic, and a studio name change later... but we hope there are still some players interested in Space Ribbon. If that's you, hi! We have some gameplay improvements that may interest you.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25891496/339b23ef7d1d19355dee1622b57fe071e152faeb.png[/img]

[h3]Updates we have made to the latest build of Space Ribbon:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Improved drift controls
[*] Streamlined game progression
[*] Fixed bugs
[*] Upgraded soundtrack (nothing revolutionary - we solved a bug in the audio)
[*] Improved vehicle handling (you [i]should[/i] fall off the track less often - if you do find the track difficulty too difficult, play more often!)
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25891496/fae417a31ce3f504ed863e1a928357f34a9424d3.png[/img]

Hope this reaches the far reaches of Steam and a few Space Ribbon stragglers. Our next update will be within a more reasonable timeframe if we spot any problems or if players would like to see anything added! Get involved with the community and just let us know.

Thanks for sticking with us all this time,

CGA Studio Games (previously Onteca)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25891496/bfcd4932b27c99bf0eb74fbbb4c7d91b23ded1de.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25891496/a2cc45f03849fd8a990e915c1f9bae0712a3e884.png[/img]

notes.title: Space Ribbon - Slipstream to the Extreme
notes.content:
Numerous small fixes, the highlights are ...

- VR comfort improvements - virtual screen for replays, better camera positioning and better ui placement, fewer uncomfortable camera motions, single pass rendering for higher frame rates.

- Track recovery times - strict limit on the amount of time you spend out of the race if you fall off the side or back of the track.

- Car handling improvements

- Track generation improvements

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25891496/5ed79da4a3f1642cc73b188be7f85d60507f8ec2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Excellent update of Space Ribbon v0.5
notes.content:
Exciting news has emerged from the world of Space Ribbon with the release of an exciting major update

This new release incorporates a number of new features including

[list]
[*] A brand new garage with customable cars

[*] An improved attract mode for more interesting replays

[*] Three levels of race difficulty

[*] Better all round performance and tightening up of gameplay

[*] Improved car handling and lots of new particles for sparks in contact and application of power

[*] Improved weapon handling

[*] Improved track generation with a lot less pacer crashing and more interesting race shapes

[/list]

This is a very big update that gets us much nearer to the end of Early Access just need to do the multiplayer and career modes now ...

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25891496/aba39f42daf57d7dcbeca87ae64813de390560f1.png[/img]

notes.title: Will run on pretty much any machine update
notes.content:
V 0.26

Accelerate moved to Z key, it was causing problems on Shift

We have heavily optimised performance for laptops and old PCs, we think the game will run on pretty much anything if you select "Fastest" from the quality drop down.  

Improved pickup graphics for the Weapons cup and you can hold one defensive weapon and one attacking one and decide when to use

Fixed most of supersmo's bug discoveries

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25891496/334239e98fda854afe20c8d1edd256b185545439.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Improved Track Creation
notes.content:
V 2.25

Big improvements to the procedural track generation, much more interesting and challenging tracks

Lots of little bug fixes for the VR particularly on Vive

Improved driving model with better collisions

Slight reordering of screens to incorporate the garage in game flow

Fix most of the attract mode messing with car select screen bugs but one more fix to come tomorrow

Don't forget we are nominated for "Best Race Game" and "Best Arcade Game" by TIGA.

You can vote for us as "Game of the Year" at http://tiga.org/awards/game-of-the-year.  We are not super confident we can beat Batman: Arkham Knight but you never know if enough people vote.

notes.title: Virtual Reality arrives in Space Ribbon
notes.content:
Virtual Reality arrives in Space Ribbon

In addition to racing amazing retro cars in space on ever changing tracks. Space Ribbon now features an amazing VR mode.

HOTFIX: Vive is tested and working great

We are pleased to announce that Space Ribbon supports Virtual Reality on both Oculus and Steam VR.  We have been playing Space Ribbon here in VR for the last 6 months and really enjoying it.  

Racing through space in VR in Space Ribbon is super cool and is so far one of the best VR experiences we have found.

Check out the quality of the car models, they just look great.  Gaze in awe as you chase the giant Tiger.

There are no screenshots that do this justice you just have to play it and say WOW.

Don't forget you will never see the same track twice and you can compete with your friends on Steam Link with up to 4 player split screen.

notes.title: Minor Update v0.11
notes.content:
Update containing minor game fixes since launch and responses to player feedback

1 - Made the Panda Cup slightly harder

2 - Sorted some visual errors in 4 player split screen

3 - Improved Race Replay to be easier to use and prettier, you can now hide the GUI with the X key, good for making videos etc.

4 - Move to Unity 5.4 (the game engine) this brings speed ups in performance for some users

Known Issues
We are working on a fix to the race rankings, occasionally in tight races the wrong finish order is reported
